angles.name: Origin: the farm
angles.primary_short: One farm. One river. Since 1997. The leather of our hornback belt comes from our own farm on the Sabie River in Hazyview, South Africa. €199, duties & taxes included.
angles.primary_long: One farm. One river. Since 1997. On the banks of the Sabie River in Hazyview, Mpumalanga, our farm is where the Seronera story begins. The hornback belt is cut along the back of the Nile crocodile skin, so each strap carries a natural ridge with its own contours. Genuine and CITES certified, from a house that gives back to South African communities through education initiatives and orphanages. Shipped from the EU, duties & taxes included. Discover the belt, €199.

scenes.name: Black on Nero marble, dark studio
scenes.prompt: Luxury product photograph, one single continuous photograph, square frame. Use the reference photo as the exact product: a Seronera hornback crocodile leather belt in black, with raised hornback scales and a natural ridge running along the strap, finished with its original buckle exactly as in the reference - keep shape, colour, scale pattern, stitching and hardware identical, do not redesign it. The belt lies in a loose, open coil with the strap tip tucked inside, the buckle small in frame and turned slightly away so no engraving is legible, resting on a polished black Nero Marquina marble surface with fine white veining in a dark studio. Composition: product horizontally centred, its whole outline between 32% and 75% of the image height and between 20% and 80% of the image width; the top 30% of the square is only empty background, deep charcoal fading to near-black; everything below 77% of the image height is only empty marble surface. Low raking side light from the left skims across the raised scales and the ridge, a soft reflection on the marble, deep calm shadows, quiet and confident mood. The whole belt is visible, no cropping, no close-up. No people, no hands, no animals, no props. No text, letters, logos, Apple logo or watermarks anywhere. Photorealistic, medium-format camera. resolution: 2k

Run a separate gifting ad set (partners and family, 28-55) around birthdays and the festive season using the gift angle.
issues_fixed: Angle 'The leather' primary_short: the product was never named ('Hornback is cut...'), so the first 125 characters did not carry the click reason on their own. Changed to 'The hornback belt is cut along the back of the Nile crocodile skin...' (197 chars total; first 125 chars now name the belt and its leather, genuine and CITES certified).

on_image[3] headline 'Made for denim.' implied the belt was designed specifically for denim, which is not stated. Replaced with 'Wear it with denim.' (19 chars, sentence case, full stop), which comes word for word from the product description ('Wear it with denim and a simple shirt').

Angle 'The leather' primary_long repeated the 'One of one' angle's core message ('so no two belts are alike'), which blurred the two angles. Replaced 'Every strap keeps its own contours, so no two belts are alike.' with 'Each strap carries a ridge with its own contours.' (taken from the product description). The angle now stays on the leather itself. Length is now 413 chars (was 426).

on_image[1] repeated 'From' in both lines ('From the Sabie River.' / 'From our own farm · €199'), which reads clumsily on one creative. Changed the subline to 'Hazyview, South Africa · €199' (29 chars, includes the price, verified location), which is more specific and pairs with the river stone scene.

Final check passed with no other changes. Every length is within its limit (primary_short 166-199/220 with the click reason in the first 125 chars; primary_long 405-476/500; headlines 28-34/40; descriptions 16-26/30; on-image headlines 16-21/22, all sentence case and ending in a full stop; sublines 20-29/32, all with €199). The copy has no emojis or exclamation marks, uses British spelling and contains no forbidden claims. All scene prompts start and end with the exact required phrases. Their frame wording matches the method, and the 1:1 (32-75% / 20-80% / top 30% / below 77%) and 9:16 (42-62% / top 40% / below 65%) composition percentages are present. No scene has a buckle close-up or people. Each one is in a different setting (Nero marble, river stone, linen and travertine, safari-lodge walnut), and every colour has a reference photo.
